verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the Browserbase session dashboard, which offers real-time screen recording and replay. That is a host-platform observability feature, not Stagehand's own capability. Nothing in the pack documents a human taking control of the browser mid-run when the agent gets stuck, which is the core of this story.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: Browserbase provides real-time visibility into your automation sessions
